> Will fixing #93830 remove the flake in this test? To @msau42's question, does this failure represent a real bug? If so, we probably want to leave the test that exposed the issue as-is

yes, #93830 is a bug that was introduced in #93511. It's a real bug which we should [fix in the scheduler code](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/93831).

This PR fixes an issue in the test that [causes failures](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/81368#issuecomment-666043508) with or without #93551. 
It's not a real bug. When a storage class supports both static and dynamic provisioning, a PVC can be bound to a static PV or dynamically provisioned. However, in some test cases of `TestVolumeBinding`, we want the PVC to be statically bound, so we must wait for pre-provisioned static PVs to be available first. Fixing this issue will not hide the #93830 issue.

take https://prow.k8s.io/view/gcs/kubernetes-jenkins/logs/ci-kubernetes-integration-master/1287138465619644420 as an example

the test `TestVolumeProvision/with_CSIStorageCapacity/wait_one_pv_prebound,_one_provisioned` fails b/c `selected-node` is set to PVC `pvc-w-pv-prebound`, which is not expected.

```
    volume_binding_test.go:1310: Provisoning annotation on PVC volume-scheduling3589f896-5d5f-486a-be2e-4b25290b159f/pvc-w-pv-prebound not as expected: PVC volume-scheduling3589f896-5d5f-486a-be2e-4b25290b159f/pvc-w-pv-prebound not expected to be provisioned, but found selected-node annotation
```

our volume binder tries to dynamically provision it:

```
I0725 22:01:59.631952  115070 scheduler.go:455] Attempting to schedule pod: volume-scheduling3589f896-5d5f-486a-be2e-4b25290b159f/pod-w-pv-prebound-w-provisioned
I0725 22:01:59.632140  115070 scheduler_binder.go:819] No matching volumes for Pod "volume-scheduling3589f896-5d5f-486a-be2e-4b25290b159f/pod-w-pv-prebound-w-provisioned", PVC "volume-scheduling3589f896-5d5f-486a-be2e-4b25290b159f/pvc-w-pv-prebound" on node "node-1"
I0725 22:01:59.632158  115070 scheduler_binder.go:819] No matching volumes for Pod "volume-scheduling3589f896-5d5f-486a-be2e-4b25290b159f/pod-w-pv-prebound-w-provisioned", PVC "volume-scheduling3589f896-5d5f-486a-be2e-4b25290b159f/pvc-canprovision" on node "node-1"
I0725 22:01:59.632187  115070 scheduler_binder.go:883] Provisioning for 2 claims of pod "volume-scheduling3589f896-5d5f-486a-be2e-4b25290b159f/pod-w-pv-prebound-w-provisioned" that has no matching volumes on node "node-1" ...
I0725 22:01:59.632244  115070 scheduler_binder.go:349] AssumePodVolumes for pod "volume-scheduling3589f896-5d5f-486a-be2e-4b25290b159f/pod-w-pv-prebound-w-provisioned", node "node-1"
I0725 22:01:59.632265  115070 scheduler_assume_cache.go:327] Assumed v1.PersistentVolumeClaim "volume-scheduling3589f896-5d5f-486a-be2e-4b25290b159f/pvc-w-pv-prebound", version 62766
I0725 22:01:59.632282  115070 scheduler_assume_cache.go:327] Assumed v1.PersistentVolumeClaim "volume-scheduling3589f896-5d5f-486a-be2e-4b25290b159f/pvc-canprovision", version 62769
```

as for https://prow.k8s.io/view/gcs/kubernetes-jenkins/logs/ci-kubernetes-integration-master/1286724218758631424

the test `TestVolumeProvision/with_CSIStorageCapacity/wait_one_bound,_one_provisioned` fails for the same reason

```
    volume_binding_test.go:1310: Provisoning annotation on PVC volume-scheduling49829bca-acdd-42c1-8dfe-b018acca07c9/pvc-w-canbind not as expected: PVC volume-scheduling49829bca-acdd-42c1-8dfe-b018acca07c9/pvc-w-canbind not expected to be provisioned, but found selected-node annotation
```

when the scheduler volume binder tries to find volumes for PVC `pvc-w-canbind`, its corresponding volume `pv-w-canbind` is not synced to volume binder `PVAssumeCache` or synced version is not in Available state

```
I0724 18:37:04.098547  114928 scheduler.go:454] Attempting to schedule pod: volume-scheduling49829bca-acdd-42c1-8dfe-b018acca07c9/pod-pvc-canbind-or-provision
I0724 18:37:04.098798  114928 scheduler_binder.go:819] No matching volumes for Pod "volume-scheduling49829bca-acdd-42c1-8dfe-b018acca07c9/pod-pvc-canbind-or-provision", PVC "volume-scheduling49829bca-acdd-42c1-8dfe-b018acca07c9/pvc-w-canbind" on node "node-1"
```

so the volume binder will try to dynamically provision it too

I think the root cause is that the scheduler fails to find matching PVs in PV Assume Cache for the PVC because the PV in the Assume Cache is not in Available state or does not exist due to event delay.

We should wait for the PV/PVC Assume Cache to be up to date before scheduling the pod. However, it's not possible in integration tests. I think we can wait for the PV to be available or bound. This should reduce failures.

review_comments: Does this mean the race exists in a real cluster too?

It's more like the uncertainty in testing. Our volume binder will try to dynamically provision if no static matching PV is found. But in some test cases, we expect the volume binder to use the static PV, so we need to wait for the PV to be available. 

I think it's fine in real clusters. In theory, it's possible that some newly created PVs may not be synced to the scheduler or not be in the available state when a PVC is created to request a PV from the storage class. But, normally both the static provisioning and dynamic provisioning are acceptable for users if a storage class supports both of them.
